documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported its business performance and strategic updates for the period ending May 2025, highlighting stable production volumes alongside margin compression driven by elevated raw material prices. Management discussed its operational readiness, commissioning of a 10 MW WHRB power plant, and green-lit plant capacity expansions approved by the MoEFCC. Additionally, the company incorporated new subsidiaries to strengthen backward integration and diversify into carbon-based recycling. Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported a significant increase in financial performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, driven by higher sales, realisations, production, and gross profit margins. Turnover grew to Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the fortune of the CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of the aluminium industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Fortune of CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of aluminium industry

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation, and packaging industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation and packaging industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Expansion of aluminium smelting capacities in India, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia is expected to provide long-term growth opportunities for CPC manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Expansion of aluminium smelting capacities in India, the Middle East and Southeast Asia is expected to provide long-term growth opportunities for CPC manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Continued emphasis on infrastructure development, power transmission projects, railway modernization, urbanization, and industrial growth is expected to support demand for aluminium and steel in India.
demand_outlook.quote: In India, continued emphasis on infrastructure development, power transmission projects, railway modernization, urbanization and industrial growth is expected to support demand for aluminium and steel, thereby strengthening the outlook for CPC and related carbon products.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand for calcined petroleum coke comes from aluminum, steel, titanium dioxide, and electrode manufacturing industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC) holds significant importance in the manufacturing of aluminium, and is also utilised in the production of steel and various other carbon-based products.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that there are no commercially viable substitutes for calcined petroleum coke in aluminum smelting.
demand_outlook.quote: There are no commercially viable substitutes for CPC in aluminum smelting.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company has invested Rs. 5,638.11 Lakhs in projects currently under construction (CWIP), which are expected to be completed within FY 2026-27.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has invested Rs. 5,638.11 Lakhs in projects currently under construction (CWIP). The completion of these projects — expected within FY 2026-27 — is anticipated to substantially increase production capacity, enabling further revenue growth and operating leverage.

capex_expansion.claim: A 10 Mega Watt power plant was commissioned at the Haldia factory on 6th March, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: During the FY 2024-25, 10 Mega Watt Power Plant was commissioned at the Haldia Factory of the Company on 6th March, 2025 and the Company has incurred Capital Expenditure of Rs.7,111.77 lakhs for the same.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received approval from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change for an expansion project.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has got approval of Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India, vide their letter dated 23rd April, 2025, for proposed expansion project of the existing plant located in Haldia, West Bengal by installation of 72,000 TPA Electrically Calcined Anthracite Plant, 60,000 TPA Coal Tar Distillation Plant and 48,000 TPA by revamping of Old Carbon Paste Plant.

margins_costs.claim: Profit Before Tax for FY 2025-26 increased by 352.84% due to higher sales, higher realisations, higher production, higher selling prices of CPC, and consequently higher gross profit margin.
margins_costs.quote: Further, Profit Before Tax (PBT) for FY 2025-26 was Rs. 3353.38 lakhs as against Rs.740.53 lakhs in the previous FY 2024-25, registering an increase of 352.84% due to higher sales, higher realisations, higher production, higher selling prices of CPC and consequently the higher gross profit margin.

margins_costs.claim: The company imports more than 90% of its raw materials from foreign suppliers, which exposes it to foreign exchange and raw material price volatility risks.
margins_costs.quote: The company imports more than 90% of its raw materials from foreign suppliers as a result of which the company faces foreign exchange risk.

orders_capacity.claim: Production of CPC for the fiscal year 2025-26 reached 1,28,689.62 MT compared to 84,305.500 MT in the financial year 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2025-26 was 1,28,689.62 MT against 84,305.500 MT in financial year 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: The Haldia plant has an installed capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC.
orders_capacity.quote: The Plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC and the plant comprises an area of around 30 acres with good infrastructure facilities like own railway sliding inside the plant premises itself facilitating unloading / loading of wagons, along with yard / shed to store both Raw Petroleum Coke (RPC) / Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC).

orders_capacity.claim: Production of calcined petroleum coke for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT against 91,541.200 MT in financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review in order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements, your Directors have decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company spent Rs. 87.77 Lakhs on corporate social responsibility activities during the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year ended 31st March, 2025, the Company has spent Rs.87.77 Lakhs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted heavy reliance on imports, especially low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and other European and Asian countries, affecting cost and availability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Heavy reliance on imports (esp. low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and Other Europe and Asian countries) affects cost and availability.

risks_headwinds.claim: The energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power and fuel inflation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power/fuel inflation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management pointed out that trade restrictions and anti-dumping duties or export and import restrictions in key markets impact pricing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets (e.g., China, USA and West Asia Market) impact pricing.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry continues to face challenges arising from volatility in crude oil and green petroleum coke prices, fluctuations in freight and logistics costs, environmental and emission-related regulatory requirements, supply-demand imbalances, and geopolitical developments.
risks_headwinds.quote: The industry, however, continues to face challenges arising from: • Volatility in crude oil and green petroleum coke prices; • Fluctuations in freight and logistics costs; • Environmental and emission-related regulatory requirements; • Supply-demand imbalances in global petroleum coke markets; • Geopolitical developments affecting energy markets and international trade.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that raw material price volatility is managed through ordering processes, diversified suppliers, and quantity management.
risks_headwinds.quote: The raw material price volatility are managed by our well-developed ordering process, diversified suppliers and quantity management.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company adopted a forex policy in June 2023 to ensure 100% hedging to minimize foreign exchange risk.
risks_headwinds.quote: In order to minimize this risk, the company adopted a forex policy in June, 2023 which ensured 100% hedging.

management_commitments.claim: The Company intends to complete the projects under construction within FY 2026-27 to substantially increase production capacity.
management_commitments.quote: The completion of these projects — expected within FY 2026-27 — is anticipated to substantially increase production capacity, enabling further revenue growth and operating leverage.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to use heavy creosote oil in place of furnace oil during production to achieve substantial savings.
management_commitments.quote: The Company is planning to use Heavy Creosote Oil in place of Furnace Oil during production. There will be substantial saving.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
